newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Jets suspends Indonesia flights.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Jets suspends Indonesia flights.

text.p: Australia's third largest airline, the privately owned National Jet Systems (NJS) Group, said on Friday it was indefinitely suspending its international operations from Monday, February 17.
NJS said weekly flights, from Broome in Western Australia to Denpasar, Indonesia, and from Darwin in the Northern Territory to Lombok, Indonesia, would be stopped for commercial reasons.

The decision followed the suspension of linked flights to the Christmas Island Indian Ocean resort, where a continuing legal dispute involving the island's casino had led to continually declining passenger loads, it said.

"The performance of this route affects the total South East Asian network and National Jet Systems' projections show that continuing operations would result in an unsatisfactory economic performance," it said.
NJS said it would consolidate its focus on its contracted aviation services, including coastal surveillance work for the Australian Government and services to remote mines.
